themes.themeName: Violation of Personal Data Protection laws
themes.sheetDetail: Data protection has become more complex with the rapid adoption of AI and digital technologies, increasing the risk of personal data loss or leakage.
themes.sheetExtra: Awareness training on PDPA requirements and sharing of case studies Mandatory e-learning modules (PDPA) Implementation of PDPA DLP software for email transmission Appointment of LOB Data Governance Officers to ensure effective operationalization of the organization’s PDPA policies and practices Data Protection Trustmark certification granted to eServ whose business involves acting as data intermediary for customer

themes.themeName: Violation of Trade Compliance and Regulations
themes.sheetDetail: The current global landscape (geo-economic volatility, US-China bifurcation and evolving trade policies of the Trump administration) presents challenges for trade compliance.
themes.sheetExtra: Centralized EC Office established at DPS Level Strengthened governance, education/training and process enforcement through centralized supervision and resources, including yearly Export Control Training and SOP/ processes at LOB/ BA Level.. Implementation of a 2-gate Export Control compliance check system whereby the independent DPS EC office will perform final compliance checks on all export transactions initiated by business units before they are permitted to be submitted to customers and partners. Two levels of export control supports provided by both EC at LOB and DPS Level. Instituted monthly EC Meetings involving all LOBs EC Heads to share good EC practices, review and create awareness of deficiencies due to human errors. Sharing of changes in trade control regulations/requirements, lessons learnt to avoid similar mistakes/errors. . Export control checklists at LOBs for different export activities related to handling of strategic control goods. Half-yearly audit on all defence transactions involving ML strategic control goods. Strengthened trade compliance with EC, Procurement, Finance, Legal and R&A support. Export Control Policy under Group R&A – Risk - 008

themes.sheetDetail: Fraud, bribery, and corruption could pose significant risks to organizational integrity, financial stability, and reputation.
themes.sheetExtra: Robust intermediary onboarding and review process including screening and completion of Group Anti-Bribery & Corruption e-learning Ongoing risk assessment on key areas/processes where fraud, bribery and corruption risk is inherently high Annual COI declaration by all staff Enhance staff awareness Mandatory Code of Business Conduct and Ethics elearning Anti-Bribery & Corruption e-learning Communication of Group risk appetite statements Reinforcement of tone at the top through email circulars and reminders to staff on key policies and consequences

themes.themeName: Breach of security regulations (including Frontier AI-related Cybersecurity Risks)
themes.sheetDetail: Lack awareness of GISO requirements for non-Defence project (N2) networks/computers. Implementation of FCL requirements and cybersecurity controls does not meet the stipulated requirements. Carriage of image-capturing devices into Red Zones. Cyber threats have escalated significantly, with AI-driven attacks, frontier AI-driven attacks, frontier AI-related data leakage risks and self-learning malware that can evade detection and quantum–driven threats challenging encryption capabilities becoming primary concerns. Rapid advances in Frontier AI may also reduce the effectiveness of existing cybersecurity products and services, requiring continuous enhancement of cybersecurity products, capabilities and controls.
themes.sheetExtra: Continuous enhancement of cybersecurity products, capabilities and controls to address evolving AI-enabled and emerging cyber threats. 3 Levels of Audit Framework implemented for N3 projects – Self-Check, Cross-Check and Independent Check. Monthly Security Spot Checks (BA). Quarterly Security Inspection by DPS Security Spot checks in Red Zones for carriage of image-capturing devices. Defence-related SOPs and IT Security for MINDEF Classified Works (aka N3 SOP) disseminated through LOB to project team for implementation and compliance. Physical/ cybersecurity policies/ frameworks/ handbooks and e-learning. Dissemination of ISM through DEN network through LOB Heads Security. Cybersecurity Management Policy for N2 Project Network available on GISO Hub, Sunburst Connect. SOC monitoring on N1 and DEN network. Project performed compliance check based on checklist provided. Pre-FCL surveys by MSD to enhance ground understanding of security requirements. Employee/ Project/ GEWCA Security Clearance (MSD). Monthly security/cybersecurity message disseminated through email to all staff. ISOC Phase 1 eLearning for personnel involved in Defence Business. N2 attestations for declared networks and computers.
themes.sheetActionPlans: Review residual risk and adequacy and effectiveness of N2 controls in 2Q 2027

themes.themeName: Major Supply Chain Disruption (including Semiconductor Memory Chip Price Escalation Risks)
themes.sheetDetail: Supply chain disruptions due to geopolitical tensions, trade restrictions, global pandemic/catastrophes, single-source dependencies, including semiconductor memory chip price escalation.
themes.sheetExtra: Incorporate contractual safeguards (including pricing mechanisms where appropriate) to mitigate the impact of price volatility and supply chain disruptions. Develop alternative sources to minimize supply concentration risk ST Engineering Supplier Code of Conduct establishes clear expectation and requirements for our suppliers’ behaviours and practices regarding environmental protection, ethical labour practices and governance. Source and evaluate alternative for single source parts to meet Product/Project technical requirement where possible with engineering support Leverage on Group Procurement CoE Team’s domain knowledge and business relationship with strategic suppliers to source/pull in orders\ Supply chain risk monitoring tool in collaboration with Group Procurement Supply Chain Resilience Team
themes.sheetActionPlans: Review residual risk and adequacy and effectiveness of existing controls (e.g. alternative supplies, contractual safeguards) in 2Q 2027
